proposals.editorialMeaningEn: exist or have a particular identity or condition
proposals.reason: The draft examples use be with an adjective or state: are cheerful and is open.
proposals.caveat: The authored meaning also mentions existence; a single copular sense does not cover every use of be.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: possess something or experience something
proposals.reason: The apartment has a balcony and the speaker has time: possession or availability.
proposals.caveat: Separate experience meanings of have need another sense rather than silently joining them.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: perform an action or complete an activity
proposals.reason: Doing exercise and doing an activity describe performing an action.
proposals.caveat: Auxiliary do in the second question must be taught separately from lexical do.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: move or travel from one place to another
proposals.reason: Both examples describe travelling to a destination.
proposals.caveat: Go has many additional A1 constructions outside this narrow movement use.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: move towards the speaker or a stated place
proposals.reason: Coming inside and coming here concern motion toward a destination or speaker.
proposals.caveat: Review prepositions and viewpoint in each teaching context.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: notice something using your eyes
proposals.reason: Seeing a river and seeing birds are literal visual perception.
proposals.caveat: Do not merge with understand or meet senses.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: pleasant, satisfactory or of suitable quality
proposals.reason: Good bread and a good conversation express desirable quality.
proposals.caveat: Review natural Persian quality adjectives separately.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: unpleasant, harmful or of poor quality
proposals.reason: A bad road and a bad dream share negative or undesirable quality.
proposals.caveat: Road condition and dream experience could warrant more specific Persian explanations.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: large in size
proposals.reason: Suitcase and pumpkin sizes are physical magnitude.
proposals.caveat: Avoid unrelated important or adult meanings.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: not difficult to understand or do
proposals.reason: The recipe and path are not difficult to use or follow.
proposals.caveat: Review the second example for idiomatic difficulty rather than inferring it from WordNet ranking.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: free from dirt
proposals.reason: Clean towels and a clean floor are free of dirt.
proposals.caveat: Only the adjective is proposed; the verb clean requires a different part of speech.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: having a low temperature
proposals.reason: Cold water and cold wind refer to a low temperature.
proposals.caveat: The feeling of being cold is nearby but may require its own usage notes.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: having a high temperature
proposals.reason: Hot tea and a hot kitchen concern physical heat.
proposals.caveat: Do not include figurative hot senses.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: having the darkest colour
proposals.reason: A backpack and an ear are black in colour.
proposals.caveat: The drafted teaching does not use figurative or social meanings.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: having the colour of snow or milk
proposals.reason: A flower and paper are white in colour.
proposals.caveat: The proposal is the colour adjective only.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: a building where people live
proposals.reason: Both examples use house as a place where people live.
proposals.caveat: Home and house are not always interchangeable in English.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: the part of the body at the end of the arm
proposals.reason: Holding a cup and washing hands refer to the body part.
proposals.caveat: The source label must not be confused with give a hand or clock hand.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: the top part of the human body containing the face and brain
proposals.reason: A hat on the head and keeping the head above water are literal body-part uses.
proposals.caveat: Keep leader, intellect and direction senses separate.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: the part of the body used to stand and walk
proposals.reason: Shoes and comparing the left and right foot point to the body part below the ankle.
proposals.caveat: The unit-of-length sense is specifically excluded.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: the whole physical structure of a person
proposals.reason: Both examples concern the living human body's physical structure.
proposals.caveat: Review whether the broad organism definition needs a narrower A1 explanation.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: move quickly using your legs
proposals.reason: Running across a playground and running in a park describe fast movement on foot.
proposals.caveat: Do not use the inherited routing-wire sense or treat the source ranking as a proficiency rating.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: hold and transport something
proposals.reason: Carrying books to a room and carrying a bottle involve supporting and transporting objects.
proposals.caveat: The second example may also imply habitually having an item with you.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: divide something with a sharp object
proposals.reason: Cutting an apple and cutting paper both divide an object with an instrument.
proposals.caveat: The broad WordNet category must be constrained by beginner-friendly examples.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: take part in a game or enjoyable activity
proposals.reason: Playing guessing and card games describes participation in games.
proposals.caveat: Instrument-playing and theatrical acting are different senses.

proposals.editorialMeaningEn: do a job or perform tasks
proposals.reason: The aunt works at a shop and the speaker works from home: paid employment.
proposals.caveat: Working hard on an assignment also uses work, but may fit a broader activity sense.
